name: 121. Typesafe SDK fidelity (#7599)
description: Regression pins for #7599: the native /typesafe surface must accept what the official TypeSafe JS SDK v0.6.0 sends and keep the native contract intact. The SDK's EntryType allows null for state, instructions and criteria descriptions, and the SDK forwards additional top-level request properties (classifier.dev uses `images`). Pre-fix, null state failed locally with 400 'failed to convert request to Bifrost format', null instructions with 'question has no instructions', null noul/score descriptions were rejected, extensions were silently dropped (an image request degraded to text-only inference), upstream headers (x-typesafe-request-id, Retry-After) were not forwarded, native error detail collapsed to error_type 'api_error', and /typesafe/v1/models served a static catalog instead of the endpoint's GET /v1/models. Cases: null state forwarded and the endpoint's own 422 validation detail relayed natively (api.typesafe.ai refuses null state, per typesafe-ai/typesafe-sdk-js#6); null instructions with criteria and null descriptions accepted; upstream request-id header forwarded on success; a bare noul relays the endpoint's own 400 verdict and native detail; extension forwarded on /v1/decisions under x-bf-passthrough-extra-params (pinned through extra_fields.raw_request, which the shared profile enables); live catalog lists documented aliases with release dates.
